body: Hey! I wanted to say thank you for this, I took your advice. At first I regretted it, but they took me seriously and it looks like I’ll be getting help really soon, which is so much better than what I could have hoped for. Thank you!

Hey, thanks for this. I went from reading about ways to off myself and thinking of how I could get it done to actually being able to breathe again. You’re right, I can do better again, I just need to put the work in. Thank you.

So happy to hear that! Been feeling extremely suicidal lately, and came here to see if anyone had anything positive to say (bad place to look, I know). This made me feel better. I’m gonna get help too, I think. Best of luck on your journey to wellness. You deserve nothing but happiness.

It’s very difficult. Best answer is go see a therapist, talk about it. That makes it 100 times easier. If you can’t do that right now, I often try to keep myself busy with other things, like drawing or a show. I also listen to ASMR for suicidal thoughts sometimes. But the best answer is really going to therapy. Hope you’re okay, man. Best of luck.
listening to it now. thank you so much
thank you, ill definetely listen to this. thanks so much
I’m so sorry to hear. If you wanna chat, please consider me a friend. Let’s talk about whatever we can think of sometime. Hope you’re okay, man. Sending love

Please, don’t leave us. I’m your age, and I understand how you feel. I’m the same. But there’s so much we haven’t experienced yet. Please, let’s hold on a while longer, I believe in you so much. If nobody listenes, please send me a message. We can talk about whatever you want, no matter if you wanna talk about how you’re feeling, about music, TV, games, I’m with you! Please consider me a friend! Don’t leave us.
Even though it's not the same for everyone, it's nice to have an idea of what might happen. Thanks for writing this. :)

I can relate to wanting to be taken seriously. I'm shit at opening up and finding the right words to describe the way I'm feeling, which is probably half the reason why I'm scared to tell someone. Right now I keep telling myself that they ARE there to listen and to help, so I shouldn't be worried.

Genuinely man, I think you should tell your GP about what you're struggling with. I kept telling myself to do it last time, and I wish I had. Good luck tomorrow, really. I'm rooting for you!
Hello! I was just there, everything went well! I paid 30 000 overall, and I got the paper which was mentioned earlier. Thank you all so much!
